card.name: The word email in contact lines
card.fires_on: The word email (or e-mail) in author or contact notes, just before an address. Also http at the start of a cited web link, and website or video after This.

modes.label: Email in contact lines
modes.description: The word email or e-mail right before an address in a byline or contact note.

modes.label: Web link start
modes.description: The http that starts a web address after Available at.

modes.label: This website or video
modes.description: A site or media noun after This, referring to the page itself.
